retained_learning: Cross-source evidence must bind source selectors, exact commits and blobs, normalization, thresholds, queries, exclusions, and write budgets before target record acquisition.
A successful reconciliation must retain every declared divergence and fail-closed control rather than compressing the result into semantic equivalence.
Exact replay and zero upstream writes establish bounded integrity and reproducibility, not generalized reliability or intelligence.
Unit verdict, task and user verdicts, Candidate state, production routing, independent external capability, AGI, and user completion are separate claims.
Request-time provenance is immutable: later workflow, CI, merge, readback, or user-input facts belong to subsequent safe boundaries and must not be backfilled.
